# Dr. Anne Metz — Counseling for Women in New Mexico

> Dr. Anne Metz, PhD, LPC, is a licensed professional counselor based in New Mexico. Her practice, Anne Metz LLC, provides counseling for women navigating perimenopause, menopause, infertility and reproductive grief, grief and loss, identity questions, and major life transitions. Sessions are held by telehealth, by appointment, for adults 18 and older.

## Key facts

- Practitioner: Dr. Anne Metz, PhD in Counselor Education & Supervision (James Madison University), Licensed Professional Counselor
- Practice: Anne Metz LLC
- Licensed in Colorado, New Mexico, Oregon, California, and Virginia
- Services: individual therapy for women via telehealth (CO, NM, OR, CA, VA)
- Insurance: in the process of being paneled as a telehealth provider with New Mexico Medicaid managed care organizations (MCOs)
- Clinical faculty, Southern New Hampshire University (graduate counseling courses)
- Free 15-minute consultations by request at https://annemetz.com/contact.html. A consultation request is not a booking; Dr. Metz reviews each request and proceeds with booking if it is a fit
- Contact: anne@annemetz.com or 434-531-2396
- Anne Metz LLC does not provide psilocybin services. Psilocybin services are provided only through a separate company, Thirty-Sixth Parallel LLC (see "Do you own any other businesses?" at https://annemetz.com/#other-businesses)
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/annemetz/
